trust_decision.summary: uv decides whether a ZIP member name (local header and central directory) is unambiguous enough to accept; at the pinned commit no name check exists beyond NUL rejection in the streaming enclosed_name and the crate enclosed_name in sync unzip, so empty or control-character names are accepted.

landing_point.why: The streaming unzip is where all earlier uv ZIP-differential validations live (CRC, size, duplicate header and path-conflict checks, gated by UV_INSECURE_NO_ZIP_VALIDATION); the local-header filename is read here.
